description: Starfighter on a pole between trees at the Çardak airfield that serves Denizli. spottingmode records the type with a question mark and links no airframe; the International F-104 Society lists F-104G 8116 at Denizli-Çardak airfield on a pole. That identity is credible but unconfirmed by a second source, so tail_number is deliberately blank and the candidate serial is stated here instead.
